links.outcome: Readability (SMOG index) of AI answers to patient prosthodontic questions
links.effect: Gemini's median SMOG index was 1.46 points higher than ChatGPT's (p = 0.004), a more advanced reading level. ChatGPT was described as more accessible to non-professionals.
links.quote: In terms of readability, Gemini generated outputs with a median SMOG index 1.46 points higher than ChatGPT (p = 0.004), suggesting a more advanced reading level.

screen.reason: The study is an offline benchmark/expert evaluation comparing the accuracy, completeness, and readability of two LLMs (ChatGPT-4o and Gemini) answering patient queries about prosthodontics, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
